tasks.label: Simulate baud_gen
tasks.command: iverilog -g2012 -o sim/baud_gen.out rtl/baud_gen.v tb/tb_baud_gen.v ; vvp sim/baud_gen.out

tasks.label: Simulate uart_tx
tasks.command: iverilog -g2012 -o sim/uart_tx.out rtl/baud_gen.v rtl/uart_tx.v tb/tb_uart_tx.v ; vvp sim/uart_tx.out

tasks.label: Simulate uart_top (full)
tasks.command: iverilog -g2012 -o sim/uart_top.out rtl/baud_gen.v rtl/uart_tx.v rtl/uart_rx.v rtl/uart_top.v tb/tb_uart_top.v ; vvp sim/uart_top.out
